supersedesDecision.reasonForSuperseding: The earlier interpretation underweighted Top1. For V75, Top1 means the actual race winner was the model's first-ranked horse and is especially important for bankers and system efficiency.

combinedDescriptive.note: Development + validation aggregation is descriptive only and is not a new independent test.

interpretation.reason: V2F improved identification of the actual winner as rank #1 from 20 to 22 on development and from 9 to 10 on locked validation. Validation Top2, Top3 and Top5 were unchanged. The one-winner validation improvement is too small to replace V2A immediately, but sufficiently relevant for V75 to retain V2F as a frozen challenger.
interpretation.promotionRequirement: Evaluate the unchanged frozen V2F candidate against V2A on genuinely new independent V75 races.
